sourceAvailability.interpretation: Observed fraction of the frozen intended questions, used as an explicit common scenario condition; not a market frequency estimate.

commonCosts.allocation: Experimental acquisition is divided among 4 arms and 8 registered questions. Each standalone policy restores the four-arm factor, retains inter-question sharing and adds its session-overhead share once. Driver overhead is divided among the 24 intended primary records.

warning: Attention, demand, pricing and reconstruction benefits are not measured. Hypothetical thresholds do not enter investment gates.
